# `pyqs` — papers, catalog, PDFs, data browser

This area owns more generated data than any other. Almost every mistake is a
hand-edit that the next regeneration erases.

## Generated files

| File | Generated by | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `catalog-data.ts` | `src/features/pyqs/scripts/generate_catalog.py` → `bun scripts/pack-pyq-catalog.mjs` | decode through `catalog.ts`; never edit |
| `pdf-catalog.ts` | `bun scripts/build-pyq-pdfs.mjs` | index of published PDFs; never edit |
| `gate-data.ts`, `gate-index.ts` | carried data | change the source, not a row |

`pack-pyq-catalog.mjs` refuses to write unless the decoded output matches the
input exactly. `build-pyq-pdfs.mjs` mirrors the dataset (removing stale files)
and writes nothing when the input is unchanged.

## Shelf

- `catalog-core.ts` reads the snapshot; `catalog.ts` binds the live feed once.
- `browse.tsx` is the screen: filters, list, empty states. `shelf.tsx` holds the
  row pieces so neither file outgrows its job.
- `importance.ts` scores a row for the saved course (current semester, papers,
  credits, theory, electives) and splits the shelf into current / most important
  / rest. A search keeps `searchSubjects` relevance order instead.
- `coverage.ts` is the honest coverage read: subjects, with-paper subjects and
  papers per branch + semester, plus the rows with no paper yet.
  `bun src/features/pyqs/scripts/audit-catalog.ts --coverage` prints it.

## Paper pages

- `/pyqs/<slug>/` is ~390 KB of server-rendered HTML carrying every paper the
  subject has ever had.
- `loadPaper` fetches once, runs `parseAllPapers` (`paper-parse.ts`), and stores
  one cache row per subject: `pyqs.papers.v1.<slug>`.
- Opening a second paper of the same subject is a `Storage` read.
- The raw HTML is never persisted; parsed data is ~9 KB.
- A bundle older than 30 days refreshes in the background; failure keeps the
  old copy, because a past paper does not change.

## Data browser

- `data` lists datasets from `/data/manifest/index.json`.
- `data.table` requires `batch`, `branch`, `sem`, `college`. A missing one is a
  "pick one" state, never a fetch with empty params.
- The index is `{ batch: { branch: [sem8_157.json, …] } }`; parse it in
  `api.ts`, not in the screen.

## Rules

- `List` for the paper browser and dataset tables; virtualised, heighted,
  reactive `each`.
- PDFs open in the native viewer or `pyqs.pdf`; allowed hosts are
  `beu.prit.eu.org`, `beu-bih.ac.in`, `beu.ac.in`.
- `pyqs.gate` handles both a GATE PDF (`url` + `title`) and the GATE index.
- No invented paper, marks, duration or year. A missing subject is a message
  with a link to the syllabus, not a fake row.
- `qa/data.test.ts` (shelf coverage, paper totals, PDF URLs) and
  `qa/registry.test.ts` (routes, push targets) are the contract; run them after
  any catalog or URL change.

## After a data change

```sh
bun scripts/pack-pyq-catalog.mjs --check
bun scripts/build-pyq-pdfs.mjs --check
./scripts/check.sh test
./scripts/size-report.sh
```
